title: Portable agent definition
description: Identity, model tier, permissions, and per-provider overlay. Connectors, schedules, tools and skills are discovered from sibling directories and are never listed here.

instructions.description: Path to the system prompt, relative to this file.

model.description: A tier. Each provider resolves it to a real id and records the resolution in the built output.

multiagent.description: Declares this agent as a coordinator over agents/<name>/subagents/*. The version pin isn't derivable from the filesystem, so it lives here, not in discovery. Every subagents/ directory must appear here, and every entry here must have a matching directory — the loader checks both directions.

providers.description: Per-provider overlay. The only block that may carry vendor-specific settings.

environment.description: Environment id sessions run in. Omit for the account default.
